sources.title: WAI Tabs Pattern
sources.publisher: W3C WAI / W3C or Android Developers
sources.read_scope: Main pattern body: one active panel, tablist/tab/tabpanel relationships, aria-selected, keyboard and latency/activation note
sources.observed: Focus and active selection differ; automatic activation is appropriate only without noticeable panel latency
sources.application_proposal: Few functional panels with correct relationships and manual activation when content is delayed

sources.title: Android WebView state API
sources.publisher: W3C WAI / W3C or Android Developers
sources.read_scope: saveState(Bundle) and restoreState(Bundle) exact method bodies
sources.observed: These APIs no longer store/restore display data; restore after already building state can have side effects
sources.application_proposal: Preserve application data/draft separately; do not assume tab reload or WebView history saves live editor content

sources.title: Resize Observer
sources.publisher: W3C WAI / W3C or Android Developers
sources.read_scope: Introduction selected observation conditions and3.4.6 loop-error paragraphs
sources.observed: Display-none changes affect observations; initial rendered nonzero size and no CSS-transform notification are explicit
sources.application_proposal: Gate tab-show rendering on positive size, observe container changes and avoid resize loops; actual WebView support unverified

sources.title: CSS Positioned Layout3 sticky
sources.publisher: W3C WAI / W3C or Android Developers
sources.read_scope: 3.4 selected nearest-scrollport/inset/sticky-rectangle paragraphs and publication status
sources.observed: Sticky uses nearest scrollport and insets; source was Working Draft when read
sources.application_proposal: Use one thin navigation owner and inspect real scroll container/overlap, not a universal browser behavior guarantee

sources.title: WAI Disclosure Pattern
sources.publisher: W3C WAI / W3C or Android Developers
sources.read_scope: Main pattern, Enter/Space, expanded state and optional controls relationship
sources.observed: Disclosure visibly hides/reveals content with button state that matches expansion
sources.application_proposal: Collapse repeated help/technical detail while keeping current unsaved/error/unconfirmed-PC state outside

library_preflight.existing_basis: Button-state manual supports selected/cancel/result/a11y; offline workflow supports draft/export/PC-apply boundaries
library_preflight.gap: Missing task-group tabs, thin current/next guidance, collapsed repetitive detail and hidden-panel layout/coordinate preservation

scope_control.reuse_instead_of_research_expansion: Current/result/dirty/a11y rules reused from existing UI_BUTTON_STATE_FEEDBACK manual

fresh_search.method: One Ego source-study space, official primary DOM bodies only

cross_checks_and_inferences: Tabs partition functional spaces; they are not a linear wizard or completion counter
A single navigation/guidance owner avoids native plus WebView duplicate headers
Critical dirty/error/PC-confirmation boundaries stay visible while repetitive technical help folds
When PC apply cannot be known, say unconfirmed rather than asserting applied/not-applied
WebView history state does not guarantee live DOM/draft/canvas recovery
Hidden panels require positive measured size before fit/redraw; original-photo coordinates stay independent
Reflow/tab changes do not authorize point/revision writes, reloads, new network calls or settings
Sticky and layout APIs require actual target WebView/device verification
not_verified: Target WebView/API compatibility and full WCAG
